notes: text: 背後から独楽が直撃ィー!! — the top scores a direct hit from behind

english: a big crisis, a tight spot
notes: text: ゴン選手初めての大ピンチ!! — Gon's first big crisis
text: ギド選手早くも4P獲得! — Gido has already earned 4 points
text: 4P獲得! — 4 points earned!

english: to see through completely, to fully read (an opponent's moves)
notes: text: 数が多すぎて動きを見切れない — there are too many, I can't fully read the movements
text: あれは発の一種ですか — is that a type of Hatsu?
text: 物質にオーラを送り込んでいるのです — he's sending Aura into matter

english: to send into, to inject into
notes: text: 物質にオーラを送り込んでいる — sending Aura into the matter
text: 比較的簡単なのは — what's relatively easy is...

english: deep emotional attachment, strong feelings (about something)
notes: text: 思い入れのある物 — an object one is emotionally attached to

english: a sign, an indication, a presence
notes: text: 気配で追おうとしてもダメだ!! — even trying to track it by presence alone is no good
text: 気配を感じとらなきゃダメだ!! — you have to sense the presence

english: "Ten" — the Nen technique of wrapping the body in aura for defense
notes: text: 纏が消えかかってる!! — his Ten is starting to fade

english: out of bounds, off the field/ring
notes: text: たまらず場外へエスケープ!! — unable to bear it, he escapes out of the ring

english: to knock out, to fling/bounce out
notes: text: はじき出された — he was knocked out

english: a way, a means (of coping) — usually in negative, "nothing one can do"
notes: text: またも直撃なす術なし!! — another direct hit, nothing he can do about it
text: 自分の纏がおろそかになって解けてしまう — his own Ten becomes neglected and comes undone
text: 気配を読むのに集中すると — if he concentrates on reading the presence

english: continuation, carrying on (a match, an activity)
notes: text: 試合続行するかね!? — will the match continue?

english: to fall silent, to be quiet
notes: text: ちょっと黙ってて — be quiet for a bit
text: カウント10以内に戻らなければ負けとするよ!! — if you don't return within a count of 10, it's ruled a loss
text: オレだけを狙って襲ってくるわけじゃないのかな — maybe it's not just aiming at and attacking me specifically

text: 複雑な機械でも生き物でもない — it's neither a complex machine nor a living thing

text: 高度な命令を与えるのは不可能です — giving it an advanced command is impossible

english: an obstacle, a nuisance, an intruder

english: to concentrate one's will on, to wish/pray mentally for
notes: text: おそらくギドが念じたのは — what Gido probably willed was...
text: 土俵を回り続け偶然ぶつかったものをはじきとばすだけ — it just keeps spinning around the ring and knocks away whatever it happens to bump into

english: to be afraid of, to fear
notes: text: コマ自体をそんなにこわがることはない!! — there's no need to be so afraid of the top itself

english: to leave alone, to leave as is (colloquial contraction of 放っておく)
notes: text: ほっといて本人を攻撃だ!! — forget it, attack the person directly!
text: ほっといて本人を攻撃だ!! — forget it, attack the person directly!
text: 無駄だね! — it's useless!
text: 竜巻独楽ア―!!! — tornado top!

english: offense and defense combined as one
notes: text: ギド選手の攻防一体必殺奥義!! — Gido's finishing move combining attack and defense as one

english: a secret technique, an ultimate/finishing skill
notes: text: 攻防一体必殺奥義!! — a finishing move combining attack and defense
text: ゴン選手に強烈なカウンター — a fierce counter against Gon
text: これでとうとう合計9P!! — with this, a total of 9 points at last

english: the edge of a cliff (idiom: dire straits, the brink)
notes: text: これでホントのガケっぷちだ!! — now he's truly at the edge of the cliff
text: 洗礼をうけて200階クラスにあがり — after going through that trial by fire and rising to the 200th-floor class

text: 確実にPを稼げる戦い方 — a way of fighting that reliably earns points

english: an amateur's thinking, a naive idea

text: 訓練次第でそんな問題は解決できるのさ — with the right training, that kind of problem can be solved
text: 倒す方法はいくつかあります…理論上は — there are a few ways to defeat him, in theory

english: to create, to produce, to generate
notes: text: オーラを瞬時に生み出す術も知らない — he doesn't even know a technique to instantly generate Aura
text: オーラを瞬時に生み出す術 — a technique to instantly generate Aura
text: 前提として大量のオーラを生み出さなければならない — as a precondition, he has to generate a huge amount of Aura

english: to master through practice, to acquire (a skill) by experience
notes: text: それを体得するには果てない修行と — to master that takes endless training and...
text: 果てない修行と — endless training and...
text: より多くの実戦を積むしかない — there's nothing to do but build up more real combat experience
text: より多くの実戦を積むしかない — there's nothing to do but build up more real combat experience

english: to feel keenly, to be painfully aware of
notes: text: 彼もそれを痛感してるはず — he must be painfully aware of that too

notes: text: 絶とは…完全に絶つ技!もちろん精孔も閉じられて…念に対する防御力は完全に0!! — Zetsu is a technique that completely cuts off Aura; the pores close too, so Nen defense drops to zero

english: an aura pore (the body's point of Nen output, in Hunter x Hunter's terminology)
notes: text: もちろん精孔も閉じられて — the aura pores close too, of course
text: 普段微弱に流れているオーラさえ消えるわけだから — because even the Aura that normally flows faintly disappears
text: 私に会う前から独学でだとしたら — if he taught himself before ever meeting me

english: an innate aptitude, a natural talent
notes: text: すごい資質を持っているわけだ — he has an incredible natural talent

english: a way of life, one's living
notes: text: そういう暮らしをしてきたのか — so that's the kind of life he's led
text: 念の攻撃を無防備で受けちまったら — if he takes a Nen attack while completely defenseless

english: to not stand a chance, to be unable to withstand at all (idiom)
notes: text: 生身の体はひとたまりもないんだぞ!! — his bare, unprotected body wouldn't stand a chance

english: all of one's nerves, one's entire focus
notes: text: 全神経を集中させなきゃ — I have to focus every last nerve
text: 纏に気をとられてる余裕はないんだ!! — there's no leeway to be distracted by my own Ten

english: risking one's life, at the cost of one's life
notes: text: あのコは命がけで — that kid is risking his life
text: 命がいらぬか小僧!! — you don't need your life, kid?!
text: ならば望み通り死ぬんだな!! — then you'll die just as you wished
text: ゴン選手が攻撃回避!! — Gon evades the attack!
text: 反撃開始の序章となるか!! — will this become the prologue to the start of his counterattack?
